campaign.title: Balanced half-shifted alias defect proof-design gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: External large-sieve, B-process, spacing, or spectral results may be used only from primary sources after the literal transformed kernel and every theorem hypothesis are matched. Structural analogy has no proof status.

frozen_target.question: Does the Round-115 zero-subtracted double-far remainder admit an explicit joint signed half-shifted-alias or local-energy inequality of total cost O(L^3 X^epsilon), after retaining the literal gcd masks, slanted symbols, determinant projector, full shift family, and fixed physical block; or can the proposed one-alias defect mechanism be rigorously parked with its smallest surviving kernel named?
frozen_target.reference_formula: R_B^osc=sum_df a_B^<(h,k) conjugate(a_B^<(h',k')) [e(R(sqrt(hk)-sqrt(h'k')))-1], with R=sqrt X asymp L^3, h,k,h',k' asymp L, |h'k'-hk|>L, and |hk'-h'k|>L. In increments h'=h+2s and k'=k+q the character is e(s/2). For the oscillatory summand, formal Poisson in s has positive half-integer alias lambda=1/2-m, stationary point x=h'=X(k+q)/lambda^2, dual phase R sqrt(hk)-X(k+q)/(2lambda)-lambda h/2. With lambda_0=R sqrt(k/h), this equals -h(lambda-lambda_0)^2/(2lambda)-Xq/(2lambda). The round must make this formal chart literal, price its errors and norms, and determine whether it yields the missing factor L.
quantities: X>=4096 real, R=sqrt X, persistent j=1, L asymp R^(1/3), and 1<=K/L<=16
one fixed physical block B with the exact Round-113 real slanted symbol, floors, tapers, stars, crossings, and support
capacity_before L^4, claimed_gain one factor L, target and survivor capacity L^3
the phase-free term is already owned and may be subtracted exactly once
no residuewise, shiftwise, divisorwise, aliaswise, or shellwise absolute value may be hidden
any stationary-phase or Poisson formula must retain boundary, gcd-expansion, gate-crossing, and nonstationary errors

completion_criteria: Derive a literal finite half-shifted alias representation, or identify the first exact obstruction caused by the gcd mask, sharp gates, support crossings, or Poisson normalization.
Verify the stationary point, dual phase, square-completed defect phase, and exact images of both double-far gates, with all constants and alias ranges.
State an explicit signed inequality whose left side contains the complete zero-subtracted remainder and whose right side exposes the precise alias norm or spacing quantity to be bounded.

Prove the L^3 target, a target-safe strict subrange, a positive-power saving, or a rigorous no-go for a named class of one-alias/large-sieve arguments; do not park BAL from a vague failure to find a proof.
Audit the reciprocal q-frequency X/(2lambda), the near-hyperbola resonance count, the lambda-defect oscillation, and every Cauchy or large-sieve factor against the L^3 budget.
Demonstrate why the proposed mechanism does not also prove the false arbitrary-coefficient analogue, or record that it is coefficient-blind and insufficient.
Do not claim BAL, any M2 parent, M9-M1, endpoint uniformity, M9, or a new exponent unless the complete graph implication is proved.

tasks.target: Independently derive the half-shifted alias chart for the supplied literal zero-subtracted remainder, including both far gates and the exact alias capacity, then either state a lawful L^3 inequality or prove the first named obstruction.
excluded_context: the Round-116 derivation packet and conductor candidate
required_output: The exact alias chart and gate images, or the first failed literal seam.
An explicit candidate inequality with capacity before and after every norm step.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Make the conductor half-shift alias defect chart literal and use it to prove the strongest signed local-energy or reciprocal-frequency large-sieve estimate available at the exact L^3 budget, or isolate the first irreducible alias norm.
required_output: A literal transformed kernel with every amplitude, alias range, and error priced.
The best proved target, subrange, saving, or precisely named survivor.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit the half-shift alias defect mechanism: derive its exact Cauchy/large-sieve diagonal and spacing costs, test near-hyperbola and resonant reciprocal-frequency controls, and decide whether the route gains a factor L or self-returns.
required_output: A pass/fail table for literal legality, alias geometry, resonance count, norm cost, source fit, owners, and downstream scope.
A rigorous named no-go if the candidate self-returns, or the exact theorem still needed if it does not.

review_seams.requirement: Poisson or stationary phase is applied only after the gcd, parity, gates, and support are decomposed into lawful amplitudes, with every error retained.
The half-integer alias, stationary point, dual phase, square completion, and both gate images agree exactly in every derivation.
The signed alias family remains assembled until a proved inequality; aliaswise or shiftwise l1 is explicitly charged.
The Poisson amplitude, alias count, reciprocal-frequency resonance count, Cauchy factor, and large-sieve diagonal are priced against L^3.
Any saving uses a literal character, symbol, gcd, or gate property unavailable to an arbitrary bounded coefficient array.
Any external result is primary-source matched to the exact dimensions, spacing, coefficient norm, real-X uniformity, and endpoint range.
The phase-free mode and both Round-114 corridors are used at most once; hard TOP, UNBAL, M1, and j=2 are not imported.
A transformed identity, reciprocal resonance count, or named mechanism obstruction is not reported as the balanced estimate without the complete L^3 bound.
